item.title: Atlanta Fringe announces 14th annual festival lineup
item.description: The lineup for the 14th annual Atlanta Fringe Festival, the city’s performing arts festival dedicated to non-traditional shows from artists in Georgia and across the world, has been announced. This year’s lineup includes 27 Georgia-based artists and 22 traveling artists performing everything from live theater, dance, and spoken word to clowning, magic, and comedy. item.title: Wrong turn leads to chaos in Publix Atlanta Half Marathon women’s race
item.description: Three elite runners were led off course by an official race vehicle during the U.S. Half Marathon Championships in Atlanta, costing them a shot at the national title and likely a spot on Team USA. item.title: Annual wine auction benefiting High Museum moves to Pullman Yards for 2026
item.description: The High Museum's annual Atlanta Wine Auction will relocate to Pullman Yards in Kirkwood for its 2026 event, featuring winemaker dinners, a live auction luncheon, and the Palette & Pour reception, with proceeds benefiting the High's exhibitions and education programs. item.title: Beloved salon dog Archer recovered 20 miles from Dunwoody a month to the day and time of disappearance
item.description: After a month of searching, Douglas Nitcher was reunited with his beloved dog Archer, who had been found more than 20 miles away from the salon where he had gone missing, thanks to the help of a kind stranger and the support of the community. item.title: APD make 14 arrests in ‘teen takover’ on the Beltline
item.description: The Atlanta Police Department arrested 14 on Saturday evening after a large group of juveniles gathered on the Atlanta Beltline Eastside Trail.
